build_mlp_network: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable hidden dims, batchnorm, and dropout using build_mlp
create_multitask_cnn_encoder: create a MultitaskCNN encoder to extract image features from RGB images for downstream tasks
encode_question_with_lstm: encode a tokenized question sequence into a fixed-length embedding using QuestionLstmEncoder
run_vqa_attention_model: run the VqaLstmCnnAttentionModel to predict answers from images and questions with attention scores
build_navigation_planner: build a NavPlannerControllerModel to plan navigation actions and control movement from questions and images
